text:
Noah (PM): quick chat 5we've had two customers say the density toggle in the model catalog is confusing and they accidentally switch to compact. options: move toggle into view settings panel, add a persistent label, or add a confirm?

Iris (Design): i don't want a confirm. propose a small persistent badge in the header showing current density (eg 'Compact view') with a one-click toggle that opens a tiny flyout for density + spacing presets. keeps discoverability without modal. mock incoming. :sparkles:

Liam (Frontend): implementation notes: header badge is trivial; flyout can be aria-menu pattern. watch out for our sticky header overlap with virtualized rows when the flyout opens. may need z-index + inert on underlying list while open.

Marta (A11y): ensure the flyout is keyboard accessible, has role="menu" or proper aria attributes, and focus returns to the toggle on close. persistent label must be perceivable (not color-only). contrast for small badges needs 4.5:1.

Zoe (Support): customers also linked this to badges disappearing after pinning a version. they expected the perf badge to stick with the pinned view. can we make the badge stick or show a small placeholder when metric data isn't available?

Iris (Design): idea: when a version is pinned, show a tiny pinned-state strip on the row with the active badges and a tooltip: "Pinned view preserved". If metric not available, show a ghost placeholder with sr-only text "metric unavailable".

Liam (Frontend): ghost placeholder is easy: render a muted icon with aria-hidden=false and sr-only label. beware perf if we render placeholders for long lists; lazy-render placeholders only for visible rows.

Marta (A11y): placeholders must not be invisible to screen readers. use aria-label="latency: unavailable". Also when pin toggles filters or view modes, announce: "Pinned view enabled: filters preserved" via aria-live.

Noah (PM): decision for prototype: header density badge + flyout, pinned-state strip that surfaces badges/placeholders, and aria-live announcements for pin actions. Iris will produce mocks; Liam will prototype behind flag and lazy-render placeholders; Marta will run an a11y pass.

deploy-bot: created branch feat/catalog-density-badge by Liam and opened PR #4990  https://git.internal/r/4990 :white_check_mark:

Iris (Design): i'll add two mock variants (badge-only vs badge+label) to figma and annotate contrast tokens.

Marta (A11y): checklist before merge: 1) flyout keyboard nav + focus return; 2) header badge contrast; 3) placeholders have aria-labels; 4) aria-live announcements for pin actions. i'll review PR. :mag:
